aigate 3.15.2

- Clarified that AIGATE_TOKEN is an all-or-nothing capability grant with no per-tool scoping by default; every service token defaults to it unless specifically overridden.
- Updated security section in documentation with strong new warnings about bearer token blast radius and agent security expectations.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Core job queue (proxq, at /q/) is now always on; removed separate flag for enabling it.
- SKILL.md updated to clarify always-on components and reflect the new default behavior.
- skill-card.md file removed.

- Major update: Expanded platform support and feature set, exposing multiple AI services via a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Bundles inference, tool use, browser automation, image generation, speech synthesis, transcription, agentic code execution, S3-compatible storage, web search, email/Telegram clients, time-series forecasting, async job queue, and a web UI—all behind one bearer token.
- Introduces automatic per-model fallback routing across providers (cloud, flat-rate, pay-per-token, local).
- All services are opt-in by environment variables; secure-by-default with strict bearer-token access.
- Updated setup instructions, security guidance, and comprehensive overview of bundled services and routing.
